alt: An interactive list of six answers to 'how much do Americans work', from 155.4 minutes per day (all diaries, unweighted) to 496.4 minutes (employed people on days they worked); each option names its population of days, weight, and sample size.
note: Weights-only extract: point estimates only; no intervals.

options.label: All person-days, unweighted
options.note: Same target as the next option, wrong estimator: weekend diaries are 48.9% of the sample but 28.8% of weighted days.

options.label: All person-days
options.note: The figure BLS publishes: 3.56 hours a day.

options.label: Weekdays only
options.note: A different population of days: Saturdays and Sundays are excluded.

options.label: Employed people
options.note: A different population of people: those employed at their interview.

options.label: Days with any work
options.note: Conditions on the outcome: only the 43.9% of days that include work.

options.label: Employed people, on days they worked
options.note: Conditions on both employment and the outcome.
options.unit: work day of an employed person

question: How much do Americans work?
subtitle: ATUS 2023, minutes per day of working and work-related activities
title: How much do Americans work? Six defensible answers
